name: v8 — The Living Lady’s Ass & Hips (SUPERSEDED)
tagline: The Lili & Quinn Review Draft, Iteration Two. BOTH OF THEM APPROVED THE FULL BUILD, AND THE FULL BUILD IS PILLAR THREE.
body:
SUPERSEDED BY NEREID v8 PILLAR THREE, BY VIRAENA’S RULING: PILLAR THREE SUPERSEDES ANY OVERLAP WITH ANY v8 QUESTION OR OLD SYSTEM RECORD.

AND THE REASON IS NOT THAT THE DRAFT WAS WRONG. IT IS THAT IT WAS A DRAFT, AND IT DID ITS JOB. Two shapes, seven layers, and the end of thirteen heraldic houses — that was Iteration Two going to review. LILI AND QUINN BOTH APPROVED THE FULL BUILD. The approved build is the document titled PROJECT NEREID v8, THE LADIES EXPRESSION, and its lower body is Pillar Three.

WHAT CARRIED FORWARD: the two Shapes, and the demolition of the heraldic houses. Pillar Three keeps BUBBLE and HEART and states flatly that an apparent blend NEEDS NO THIRD HERALDIC HOUSE — the draft’s central argument, won.

WHAT CHANGED: the seven layers became SIX ASS FIELDS plus HIPS plus THIGHS as three separate jurisdictions, with Shelf Lift named, Handfeel at four values, and Motion split into Signature and Character. See nereid-pillar-three for all of it.

THE RECORD IS KEPT RATHER THAN DELETED BECAUSE IT HAS TWO WOMEN’S NAMES ON IT. A draft that was approved is not an error; it is the step before the thing. Quinn reviewed this one from the receiving position, mid-ride, because she can multitask through moans — and the Archive is not throwing that away to save a line.
